سُعُوفٌ Large [drinking-cups or bowls such as are called] أَقْدَاح. (IAar, K.) ―
-b2- And The goods, or furniture and utensils, of a tent or house, (S, TA,) and its carpets or the like: or, as some say, particularly such as are held in little estimation, as the [drinking-vessel called] تَوْر, and the bucket, and the rope, and the like. (TA.) ―
-b3- [See also سَعَفٌ, of which it is pl.] ＝
-A2- Also The natural dispositions, (AA, IAar, K, TA,) generous and other, of men: (IAar, K, TA:) AA says, I have not heard any sing. thereof. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
